user.title: NSPanel UI Config
user.description: Configuration layer for the AppDaemon backend (nspanel-lovelace-ui).

data.output_path: Output path of the generated YAML (inside the shared bind mount)
data.reload_touch_path: Only for "touch_module": path of the file to touch
data.reload_container: Only for "restart_container": name of the AppDaemon container
data.import_yaml_path: Optional: path of an existing apps.yaml to import
data.backup_count: Number of backups to keep for the output file

data_description.reload_mode: AppDaemon does not notice a changed !include file by itself. "none" = reload manually, "touch_module" = update the mtime of a file AppDaemon watches, "restart_container" = restart the AppDaemon container through the Docker API.
data_description.reload_touch_path: A file AppDaemon watches – its app module (apps/nspanel.py) or the apps.yaml. It must be visible inside the HA container, i.e. mounted in as well.
data_description.reload_container: Requires /var/run/docker.sock to be mounted into the HA container.
data_description.backup_count: Before every overwrite the previous state is copied into a "backups" subdirectory next to the output file; older ones are pruned to this count. 0 disables backups – a mistake in the editor is then irreversible.

abort.already_configured: NSPanel UI Config is already set up.
